capabilities: Create sticky-note windows from Markdown files
Keep note windows above other applications
Designate and toggle a top-level sticky note
Restore sticky-note windows after reload or restart
Assign colors and edit/reading views per sticky window
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian desktop 1.5.1 or newer. Always-on-top does not work under native Wayland on Linux (X11/XWayland only). The README includes a one-time upgrade procedure for installing version 1.0.7 and notes the plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian's popout windows behave as ordinary windows, so users cannot keep vault notes pinned above other applications as quick sticky notes.
summary: Desktop-only plugin that opens Markdown files as resizable, always-on-top sticky-note popout windows that stay in sync with the vault.
